entries.appliesTo: the State Bar of California (content developed by or at its explicit direction for the State Bar examinations and study materials)

dutySources.disclosure-ui: § 6060.15(b), (c), (e) — 'the State Bar shall disclose the use of artificial intelligence-generated content in developing or administering the State Bar examinations'; 'the State Bar shall disclose the use of any artificial intelligence-generated content in study material'; 'shall be posted on the State Bar’s internet website'; 'shall be made on the cover page of the study material'

sources.aiRule: § 6060.15(b) — 'the State Bar shall disclose the use of artificial intelligence-generated content in developing or administering the State Bar examinations, including any related question, performance test, answer key, or scoring rubric.'
sources.profession: § 6060.15(a)(4) — '“State Bar examinations” means the general bar examination, the first-year law students’ examination, as described in Section 6060, and the attorneys’ examination as described in Section 6062.'

flags: family fit: text binds the State Bar, 'a public corporation' (digest), so category is public-sector; family coded professional-services because the regime is AI-disclosure rules for a licensed-profession examination — the public-sector family's params (inventory/procurement/assessment) match nothing in this text
timing rule with no param slot: § 6060.15(e)(1) — 'shall be posted on the State Bar’s internet website 60 days before the examination in which the artificial intelligence-generated content is used'
scope rule with no param slot: § 6060.15(d) — disclosure duties 'apply regardless of whether the artificial intelligence-generated content is revised or reviewed by a natural person'
scope limit: duties apply only to 'content developed by or at the explicit direction of the State Bar' (§ 6060.15(b), (c))
operative date: § 6060.15(f) — 'This section shall become operative on January 1, 2028'
no penalty or enforcement provision in the text — exposure omitted (silence is silence)
